$comment: Paths in the container image whose vulnerabilities we cannot remediate.
A finding matched here is reported as a WARNING and never fails the build;
everything else blocks. See issue #728 and the postmortem
Add an entry ONLY when the vulnerable file is vendored inside something we
do not control — i.e. no lockfile bump, npm override, or Dockerfile line can
change its version. Anything we can upgrade belongs in the blocking set.
Patterns are globs matched against Trivy's PkgPath (falling back to Target).
'**' crosses directory separators, '*' does not. A leading '/' is optional.

vendored.reason: npm CLI bundled inside the node:25-bookworm-slim base image. Not in our lockfile; fixable only by an upstream Node base-image rebuild.
esbuild Go binary bundled inside drizzle-kit. Build/migration-time only, no runtime network surface; fixable only when drizzle-kit bumps its esbuild range.
